capabilities.why: Same-ID stop/resume on an ephemeral Celesto guest preserved sentinels on its root disk, including /root; the DPR pause/resume persistence requirement is met without an external volume.

Phase 0 verified port 8000 publish, external HTTP 200, same-ID stop/resume with app restart and same-URL response, revoke to HTTP 404, and guest cleanup. The learner manager flow remains assigned to M6.

The normal project adapter set network_policy=off on pinned Celesto SDK 0.1.7 creates; the per-attempt curl self-check was blocked with exit 28 while a published inbound marker returned HTTP 200, and SIGINT cleanup confirmed revocation and deletion.
